entries.note: He is quoting his own May 2022 essay and standing by it. 'Not as smart as it seems' has no measure that most readers would agree on.

entries.test: The results of the 2022 Marcus, Davis and Aaronson DALL-E 2 evaluation and the Leivada et al. replication, on prompts with complex syntax and words like 'similar'.
entries.note: Self-quote from 2022. The proposition drops 'especially', a small change that still captures the core claim.

entries.test: The Microsoft Designer screenshot in the post, and whether the same prompt gave the same failure in Designer/DALL-E 3 in February 2024.
entries.note: The post never describes the Gemini failure. The drafter's word 'compositional' is inferred from context.

entries.test: The screenshot in the post showing what came back for his horse-rides-astronaut-with-cherries prompt.
entries.note: The post does not name the platform; by context it is probably Microsoft Designer/DALL-E 3. The target 'image generation models' is broader than the claim.

entries.test: Whether DALL-E 2 drew a horse riding an astronaut when the prompt was rephrased canonically but failed on 'horse rides astronaut'.
entries.note: He restates his 2022 conclusion and endorses it again.

entries.test: Whether DALL-E 2 succeeded on rephrased prompts for the scene but failed on the literal phrase 'horse rides astronaut'.
entries.note: This paraphrases the claim just before it.
'Anything is possible' is sarcasm that sets up the failed attempts that follow. The drafter's proposition turns the irony into a literal claim about all text-to-image models.

entries.test: The final Gemini screenshot in the post: whether one of the three images shows a horse riding an astronaut.
entries.note: This is a single personal trial, documented by screenshots.

entries.test: Whether Gemini in February 2024 produced a correct horse-riding-astronaut image only after several failed tries, as the dialogs in the post show.
entries.note: Read 'pulling teeth' as needing many attempts.

entries.test: Scores on compositionality and factuality benchmarks (e.g. T2I-CompBench, GenEval, TruthfulQA) for 2022 models versus early-2024 models.
entries.note: 'Since 2022' comes from context ('fast forward... year of hype'). Benchmark gains from DALL-E 2 to DALL-E 3 bear directly on the claim.
